mkdir ancestor
exec card --store ancestor/.cardamom init --prefix ancestor-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/ancestor-init.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: ancestor-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > ancestor/.cardamom/config.yaml'
mkdir ancestor/a/b
mkdir environment
mkdir explicit
exec card --store environment/.cardamom init --prefix env-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/environment-init.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: env-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > environment/.cardamom/config.yaml'
exec card --store explicit/.cardamom init --prefix flag-
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-init.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "version: 1\nissue:\n  id:\n    prefix: flag-\n    strategy: sequential\n" > explicit/.cardamom/config.yaml'
cd ancestor/a/b

# CARDAMOM_STORE overrides ancestor discovery, and --store overrides CARDAMOM_STORE.
env CARDAMOM_STORE=$WORK/environment/.cardamom
exec card create 'environment board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/environment-create.txt
exec card --store $WORK/explicit/.cardamom create 'explicit board'
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/explicit-create.txt

-- golden/ancestor-init.txt --
initialized ancestor/.cardamom
Automatic local exclusion failed. Add these patterns to .gitignore:
.cardamom/board.sqlite3
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-shm
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-wal
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/environment-init.txt --
initialized environment/.cardamom
Automatic local exclusion failed. Add these patterns to .gitignore:
.cardamom/board.sqlite3
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-shm
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-wal
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/explicit-init.txt --
initialized explicit/.cardamom
Automatic local exclusion failed. Add these patterns to .gitignore:
.cardamom/board.sqlite3
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-shm
.cardamom/board.sqlite3-wal
.cardamom/blobs/
-- golden/environment-create.txt --
env-1
-- golden/explicit-create.txt --
flag-1
